tool_input.command:
set -u
t=$(mktemp -d); d="$t/dest"; mkdir -p "$d"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000 20260105-000000; do
  printf 'a\n' > "$d/demo-$s.tar.gz"; : > "$d/demo-$s.tar.gz.sha256"
done
printf 'a\n' > "$d/notes.tar.gz"; : > "$d/notes.tar.gz.sha256"

echo "--- surplus: 5 archives, keep 3 (expect oldest 2 deleted, newest 3 + stray kept)"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest="$d" --name demo --keep 3
echo "rc=$?"
ls "$d" | sort | tr '\n' ' '; echo

echo "--- dry-run: would delete oldest surplus"
printf 'a\n' > "$d/demo-20251231-235959.tar.gz"; : > "$d/demo-20251231-235959.tar.gz.sha256"
bash rotate.sh --quiet -n --dest "$d" --name demo --keep 3
echo "rc=$?"

echo "--- keep=0 rejected (rc=1)"; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$d" --name demo --keep 0 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- unknown flag rejected (rc=1)"; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$d" --name demo --bogus 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- missing --name rejected (rc=1)"; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$d" --keep 2 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- --help exits 0"; bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- verify flags: --dest=, -q, -h; unknown flag rc=1"
bash verify.sh -q --dest="$d"; echo "rc=$?"
bash verify.sh -h >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
bash verify.sh --dest "$d" --bogus 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- positional args rejected by both"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$d" --name demo extra 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$d" extra 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

echo "--- log prefix on verbose rotate names rotate.sh (not common.sh)"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$d" --name demo --keep 99 2>&1 >/dev/null | head -1
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Smoke-test refactored rotate.sh and verify.sh flags and surplus logic

tool_input.command: rm -f /tmp/smoke_rotate_verify.sh && ls -l lib/ && git status --short && git diff --stat
tool_input.description: Clean up smoke script, show file permissions and diff summary

result:
Done. Summary of what changed:

**Bug fixes**
- `rotate.sh`: `surplus()` used `tail -n +N` on an oldest-first sorted list, which selected the *newest* entries — so with exactly N backups it deleted the newest one. Now it deletes the oldest `total - keep` entries (`head -n`), exits "nothing to rotate" when `total <= keep`, and leaves the newest N (plus non-conforming files) untouched.
- `verify.sh`: sidecar lines were split with `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating `my backup-….tar.gz` to `my` → "archive missing" → BAD/exit 2. Now `read -r expected file <<< "$line"` keeps the name after the digest whole, and the digest comparison is properly quoted (`[[ "$expected" == "$actual" ]]`).

**Refactor**
- New `lib/common.sh` holds the one true copy of the option-parsing block (`--dest/--name/--keep/-q/-n/-h/--`, `is_uint`, `need_value`, KEEP validation) and `resolve_dir`, with a double-source guard; it requires the sourcing script to define `usage` and `parse_local_option` first, as before. `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` source it (after `lib/log.sh`, so `LOG_PREFIX` stays correct — verified in the smoke test); `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` are untouched.

**Tests** — added a "names with spaces" check to the verify section and a new rotate section (exactly-3/keep-3 deletes nothing, newest archive kept). Per the repo's DESIGN.md rule, I confirmed all three new checks **fail on the buggy code** (reproducing the exact reported symptoms) before applying the fixes. `bash tests/run_tests.sh`: 9/9 ok, `all tests passed`. (Left behind a throwaway `/tmp/smoke_rotate_verify.sh`; deleting it needed approval I didn't push for.)

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, new `lib/common.sh`.
